name: run_motion_video
description: Build a CLI command for creating an 8-second animated evuedit portrait video from a still image. Exactly one of file and input_dir must be non-null. Long headlines wrap and are fitted automatically. The CLI requires FFmpeg.

file.description: One background image path. Set null when input_dir is provided.

input_dir.description: Folder of background images. Set null when file is provided.

foreground.description: Optional transparent PNG/WebP subject cutout path.

headline.description: Headline text to wrap, fit, and animate.

output.description: Output MP4 filename. In folder mode, the CLI derives names from source images and template ID.
